Build a Spatial Neighborhood Edge List from 2-D Cell Coordinates

Source: R/create_Edgelist_Spatial.R
create_Edgelist_Spatial.Rd

Constructs a directed edge list representing spatial cell neighborhoods. Two computation modes are available for inter-cell edges:

  • kNN mode – finds k nearest neighbors per cell via a kd-tree (RANN::nn2). Only mutual edges are retained (A->B kept only if B->A also exists). Non-mutual edges are discarded.

  • Radius mode – finds all cells within Euclidean distance rad via a kd-tree (dbscan::frNN). Edges are inherently symmetric.

Autocrine self-loop edges (A->A, distance = 0) are always appended for every cell in both modes.

Usage

create_Edgelist_Spatial(coord, k = NULL, rad = NULL, n.cores = 1L)

Arguments

coord

data.frame. First column = x, second column = y. Row names must be unique cell identifiers.

k

integer or NULL. Number of nearest neighbors (kNN mode). Positive integer.

rad

numeric or NULL. Neighborhood radius (radius mode). Positive finite number in the same units as coord.

n.cores

integer. CPU cores. Default 1. Uses socket-based clusters (parallel::makeCluster) which work on all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux).

Value

A data.table keyed on (from, to) with columns:

from

Sending cell barcode (character).

to

Receiving cell barcode (character).

distance

Euclidean distance; 0 for self-loops (numeric).

x.from, y.from

Sending cell coordinates (numeric).

x.to, y.to

Receiving cell coordinates (numeric).

Carries metadata attributes: mode, param, n.cells, cell.names.

Details

This function is a low-level primitive: it builds the spatial edge list that create_NICHESObject consumes internally. Most users should call create_NICHESObject(mode = "spatial", ...), which invokes this function and assembles the result into a full NICHESObject in one step. create_Edgelist_Spatial() is exposed for power users who want to inspect or post-process the edge list, benchmark alternative k or rad values without re-running the scoring step, or feed the edges into a non-NICHESv2 scoring pipeline.

Parameter resolution (priority):

  1. Both NULL / invalid -> default k = 4.

  2. Both valid -> radius mode; user notified.

  3. Only rad valid -> radius mode.

  4. Only k valid -> kNN mode (mutual edges only).

Examples

set.seed(1)
co <- data.frame(x = runif(50), y = runif(50),
                 row.names = paste0("cell_", 1:50))
el <- create_Edgelist_Spatial(co, k = 5)
#> [create_Edgelist_Spatial] Mode: kNN    | Param: 5 | Cells: 50 | Inter-cell: 198 | Autocrine: 50
el.rad <- create_Edgelist_Spatial(co, rad = 0.2)
#> [create_Edgelist_Spatial] Mode: radius | Param: 0.2 | Cells: 50 | Inter-cell: 286 | Autocrine: 50
